requirementChanges.statement: Listing the to-do items shows every incomplete item and skips done ones.
scenarios: [AC0001.1] Each incomplete item is shown on its own line as its number, ". [ ] " and its title.
[AC0001.3] Items are numbered from 1 in the order they are listed.

requirementChanges.statement: Marking an item complete takes it off the list of incomplete items.
scenarios: [AC0003.1] A completed item is no longer shown on the list.
[AC0003.2] The other items keep their order after one is completed.
[AC0003.3] Completing a number that is not on the list is refused and leaves the list unchanged.
[AC0003.4] Completing without a single whole number is refused and leaves the list unchanged.
